## Analysis overview

Selects weight records, identifies baseline, Week 24, and end-of-treatment observations, derives subject-level changes, and summarizes the changes by treatment and visit.

## ADaM datasets

- `ADVS`
- `ADSL`

## Key ADaM variables

- `PARAM`: analysis parameter, restricted to Weight (kg)
- `AVAL`: analysis value
- `ABLFL`: baseline flag
- `AVISIT`: analysis visit
- `USUBJID`: subject identifier
- `TRTP`: planned treatment
- `ARM in ADSL`: denominator treatment.
